title: Trainn MCP
lede: Trainn MCP connects Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP-compatible agent to Trainn so a chat can produce and revise product videos, help articles and customer courses, with every result held as a draft.

points: Turns plain screen recordings into narrated product videos with AI voiceover, zoom effects and highlights.
Writes step-by-step help articles from product notes, transcripts or existing videos.
Builds full courses with chapters, lessons and quizzes that customers enrol in, with progress tracking.
Given release notes, it finds content that has gone out of date, suggests fixes and applies them in the same chat.
Everything is saved as a draft in Trainn; nothing is published until someone presses publish.

sections.text: Customer education and onboarding teams whose product ships faster than their training content can be updated, and who already draft with Claude or ChatGPT.
The launch comment says you can connect a tool and start for free; paid tiers are not described.
